SELECT FROM rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} AND rpt03_week_start_date = #{startDate}::date AND rpt03_week_close_date = #{closeDate}::date
AND rpt03_biz_type != '999'
AND rpt03_biz_type = '999'
ORDER BY rpt03_seq

SELECT FROM rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_week_start_date < #{startDate}::date AND rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} AND rpt03_biz_type != '999' ORDER BY rpt03_week_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_week_start_date = (#{startDate}::date - INTERVAL '1 week') AND rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} AND rpt03_biz_type != '999' ORDER BY rpt03_week_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt03_week (rpt03_week_id, rpt03_company_id, rpt03_person_id, rpt03_week_start_date, rpt03_week_close_date, rpt03_biz_type, rpt03_content, rpt03_due_date, rpt03_seq, rpt03_bold, rpt03_note) SELECT f_create_seq(), rpt03_company_id, rpt03_person_id, #{startDate}::date, #{closeDate}::date, rpt03_biz_type, rpt03_content, rpt03_due_date, rpt03_seq, rpt03_bold, rpt03_note FROM rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} AND rpt03_week_start_date = #{beforeStartDate}::date AND rpt03_biz_type != '999'

INSERT INTO rpt03_week (rpt03_week_id, rpt03_company_id, rpt03_person_id, rpt03_week_start_date, rpt03_week_close_date, rpt03_biz_type, rpt03_content, rpt03_due_date, rpt03_seq, rpt03_bold, rpt03_note) VALUES (#{weekId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.weekStartDate}, #{req.weekCloseDate}, #{req.bizType}, #{req.content}, #{req.dueDate}, #{req.seq}, #{req.bold}::text, #{req.note})
mapper.select: WITH sys_code AS ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'WeekBizType' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b WHERE b.sys09_code_kind_id = a.sys09_code_kind_id AND b.sys09_company_id = a.sys09_company_id AND b.sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND b.sys09_apply_date <= #{stdDate} ) AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) SELECT sys09_code AS code , sys09_name AS name FROM sys_code LEFT OUTER JOIN rpt05_week_biz_class ON ( rpt05_week_biz_type = sys09_code AND rpt05_person_id = #{personId} ) WHERE COALESCE(rpt05_un_use_yn,'true') != 'true' AND sys09_code != '999' ORDER BY sys09_seq

WITH sys_code AS ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'WeekBizType' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b WHERE b.sys09_code_kind_id = a.sys09_code_kind_id AND b.sys09_company_id = a.sys09_company_id AND b.sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND b.sys09_apply_date <= #{stdDate} ) AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) SELECT COALESCE(rpt05_week_biz_class_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) AS week_biz_class_id , sys09_code AS week_biz_type , sys09_name AS week_biz_type_name , COALESCE(rpt05_un_use_yn,'true') = 'true' AS un_use_yn FROM sys_code LEFT OUTER JOIN rpt05_week_biz_class ON ( rpt05_week_biz_type = sys09_code AND rpt05_person_id = #{personId} ) ORDER BY sys09_seq

WITH current_week AS ( SELECT rpt03_biz_type , rpt03_week_start_date , rpt03_content , rpt03_due_date , rpt03_bold , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rpt03_biz_type ORDER BY rpt03_seq) AS row_num FROM public.rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_week_start_date = #{startDate}::date AND rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY rpt03_biz_type, rpt03_seq ), last_week AS ( SELECT rpt03_biz_type , rpt03_week_start_date AS rpt03_last_week_start_date , rpt03_content AS rpt03_last_content , rpt03_due_date AS rpt03_last_due_date , rpt03_bold AS rpt03_last_bold , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rpt03_biz_type ORDER BY rpt03_seq) AS row_num FROM public.rpt03_week WHERE rpt03_week_start_date = (#{startDate}::date - INTERVAL '1 week') AND rpt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt03_person_id = #{personId} AND rpt03_biz_type != '999' ORDER BY rpt03_biz_type, rpt03_seq ) SELECT COALESCE(c.rpt03_biz_type, p.rpt03_biz_type) AS biz_type , COALESCE(p.row_num, c.row_num) AS rd_seq , f_cdnm('WeekBizType', COALESCE(c.rpt03_biz_type, p.rpt03_biz_type), #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS biz_type_name , p.rpt03_last_week_start_date AS last_week_start_date , p.rpt03_last_content AS last_content , p.rpt03_last_due_date AS last_due_date , COALESCE(p.rpt03_last_bold, 'false') = 'true' AS last_bold , c.rpt03_week_start_date AS week_start_date , c.rpt03_content AS content , c.rpt03_due_date AS due_date , COALESCE(c.rpt03_bold, 'false') = 'true' AS bold FROM last_week p FULL OUTER JOIN current_week c ON p.rpt03_biz_type = c.rpt03_biz_type AND p.row_num = c.row_num ORDER BY COALESCE(c.rpt03_biz_type, p.rpt03_biz_type), COALESCE(p.row_num, c.row_num)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_long01, sys99_string01, sys99_date01, sys99_text01, sys99_string03 , sys99_date02, sys99_text02, sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_string08 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , #{row.rdSeq}, #{row.bizTypeName}, #{row.lastWeekStartDate}, #{row.lastContent}, #{row.lastDueDate} , #{row.weekStartDate}, #{row.content}, #{row.dueDate}, #{row.bizType}, #{row.lastBold}::text, #{row.bold}::text )
